# SasaVenos Says Strength Training Is The Peak Of Specificity For Getting Stronger

SasaVenos says that if your goal is to get stronger, strength training is the peak of specificity, hypertrophy training can positively affect strength, flexibility training could be neutral, and endurance training will have a negative effect on strength. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]

## Details

- Strength training is the peak of specificity for getting stronger. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]
- Hypertrophy training can positively affect strength. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]
- Flexibility training could be totally neutral, no benefit but also no damage. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]
- Endurance training will have a negative effect on strength, depending on how much you do it and what modality of cardio you are doing. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]

## Evidence

- vid-BBuB0XMVhDw (SasaVenos): "So if your goal is to get stronger, which I suppose it is if you're watching this video, strength training is the peak of specificity."
- vid-BBuB0XMVhDw (SasaVenos): "Hypertrophy training can positively affect strength."
- vid-BBuB0XMVhDw (SasaVenos): "Flexibility training, for example, could be totally neutral, so no benefit, but also no damage."
- vid-BBuB0XMVhDw (SasaVenos): "And endurance training will have a negative effect on strength, of course, depending on how much you do it and what modality of the cardio you're doing."
